excerpts: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and UK GDPR require us to explain the valid legal bases we rely on in order to process your personal information. As such, we may rely on the following legal bases to process your personal information:

Consent. We may process your information if you have given us permission (i.e., consent) to use your personal information for a specific purpose. You can withdraw your consent at any time. Click here to learn more.

Obtaining Resume Data: We use Google APIs to collect resume data. The resumes are processed to extract significant details and to remove personal identifiers. This anonymized information is then sent to our AI tools to refine and enhance candidate profile creation.

Important Note: We explicitly affirm that any information obtained from Google APIs is not used to develop, improve, or train generalized AI or Machine Learning models. The data is strictly used for the above-mentioned purposes and remains anonymized throughout our processes.
